cohort: 52 pregnant patients with liver diseases presenting as jaundice at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Government Medical College, Kozhikode, India, from March 2016 to September 2017.
finding: Liver disease complicated 0.22% of pregnancies (52/24060 deliveries) with a perinatal mortality rate of 122 per 1,000 cases of liver disease and one maternal death due to fulminant hepatic failure secondary to hepatitis A.
mod_finding: Of the 52 cases, 23 underwent cesarean delivery and 29 had vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Most cases (40.4%) were between 34 and 37 weeks of gestation.
